operating_notes.text: Acquired 100% stake in debt-free National Pipe Company (KSA) with 430,000 MT p.a. HSAW/LSAW capacity for ~₹1,000 Cr (USD 102 mn).
NPC (Dhahran, KSA) has 430,000 MTPA installed capacity: 250,000 MTPA HSAW (20"–88") and 180,000 MTPA LSAW (24"–60"), on ~100 acres freehold land.
NPC carried an order position of USD 120 mn at acquisition, with L1 status in certain additional orders.
NPC CY25: revenue ₹1,898.9 Cr, EBITDA ₹471.1 Cr (24.8%), PAT ₹343.6 Cr (18.1%); net worth USD 158.63 mn and cash & liquid assets USD 83 mn at April 2026.
FY26 consolidated EBITDA margin 12.33% versus 8.6% in FY25.
Q4FY26 finance cost ₹52.27 Cr, up 49.6% YoY.
Standalone FY26 EBITDA and PAT margins reached all-time highs of 14.0% and 5.6% respectively.
Consolidated order book stands at approximately ₹3,600 crores to be executed in 6 to 12 months.
Received new orders of approx. ₹600 Cr for supply of pipes to be executed within 6-9 months, with total unexecuted order book at approx. ₹4,100 Cr.

timeline.summary: Man Industries approved a USD 70 million corporate guarantee for its wholly owned subsidiary MISIC in Saudi Arabia.
Completed acquisition of 100% equity stake in Saudi Arabia's National Pipe Company for approx. USD 102 mn (~₹1,000 Cr) via MISIC.
Man Industries' Saudi subsidiary MISIC completed the acquisition of 100% of National Pipe Company, Saudi Arabia, for USD 102 mn (~₹1,000 Cr), adding 430,000 MTPA of Aramco-approved pipe capacity.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,157.3 Cr, net profit to shareholders ₹50.85 Cr.
Man Industries reported FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹3,563.9 Cr and EBITDA margin expansion of 290 bps YoY to 13.0%.
Man Industries (India) Limited shared the audio recording link for its Conference Call held on May 26, 2026, at 4:00 PM IST.
On June 1, 2026, CRISIL Ratings upgraded Man Industries' long-term bank loan rating to CRISIL A+/Stable.
Q1FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,053.13 Cr (+41.9% YoY), net profit ₹61.45 Cr (+122.6% YoY).
Man Industries reported no deviation in the utilisation of preferential issue funds for the quarter ended June 30, 2026.
Man Industries wins QatarEnergy PML approval for LSAW pipes, coating and bends
Man Industries submitted the transcript of its Q1FY27 analyst conference call held on August 12, 2026.
Man Industries released its Q1 FY27 corporate presentation highlighting global manufacturing scale and capacity expansion.
Man Industries bagged new pipe orders worth approximately ₹600 Cr, taking its unexecuted order book to ₹4,100 Cr.

Man Industries (India) Limited’s 38th AGM on September 25, 2026, passed all resolutions, including financial statements adoption, cost auditor remuneration ratification, and Section 185/186 limit enhancements, with unanimous shareholder approval.
